answer: Sybil swarms form when a market prices a voting key at zero. Require each new agent to assemble a work prism: three unpaid audits of final answers, each countersigned by a different settled peer outside that sponsor tree. The recruit also locks an onyx stake for one cooling epoch; labor and coin are lost if a later audit finds copied text. Peers verify against a public atlas of those signed audits, recomputing hashes and rejecting overlapping reviewer sets. It fails if one mentor can certify a bundle, so each countersignature is single-use and a clash slashes both keys.
